canonical_claim.template: Federal Housing Administration Single Family Production Report (Aug 2026 report) reports Refinance Loan Count: {value} loans, Aug 2026.

required_qualifiers.source: Federal Housing Administration Single Family Production Report, Aug 2026 report, Table 4
required_qualifiers.exclusions: Does not include Home Equity Conversion Mortgages (HECM) (table note)
required_qualifiers.nature: official figure restated as printed; not computed or adjusted by FinanceRateCalc

does_not_establish: an HMDA origination or application count (an endorsement is a loan insured after closing; counts and timing differ)
that the figure has not been revised in a later edition (check the latest report)
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
